items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: Then there was AJ P. Rohn. You heard of him?

ctx.x: Well he was the one with the music of Panama that I recorded. It was written as a Spanish tune. You play it. And we go boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, you know, and you'll put the old swing to it. Yeah. He says I'll let it to you but to no one else. Then there was AJ P. Rohn. You heard of him?
